title: WorkerNotification
description: One worker-wide notification, the `data` payload of a Server-Sent Event on GET /notifications. The stream is live-only (no backlog): a completion that occurs while no client is connected is not delivered — the run still surfaces as a produced run and drops out of GET /runs/active. Today the only kind is `run-completed`, emitted once per run reaching a terminal state.

kind.description: The notification kind. Only `run-completed` exists today; carried explicitly so a client can switch on it as more are added.

jobId.description: The live stream/job id the run was observed under.

harnessSlug.description: The harness that drove the run, as its slug string.

modelId.description: The model id passed to the harness.

outcome.description: How the run ended. `completed` means it produced a record (the record's own `status.state` distinguishes a completed run from one classified as failed/unevaluable); `failed` means it could not be driven to a record at all.

recordId.description: The produced run record's id — what a client links the alert to. Present only when `outcome` is `completed`; omitted otherwise.

message.description: A human-readable failure reason. Present only when `outcome` is `failed`; omitted otherwise.
